notes:
Docs: the agent can create and edit documents in a new built-in Docs editor with rich text, tables, tasks, images and comments, export them to Markdown, and take comments or requests from them. Documents are stored locally; there is no multi-user collaboration or sharing.
Video annotations: draw boxes, arrows, text and pins on the editor preview and send them to the agent with your message; clicking a note jumps to that moment. Available in the desktop app.
Local speech synthesis now runs on the bundled audio.cpp engine (Metal on macOS, Vulkan on Windows) with nine models: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B and 1.7B Base, 1.7B CustomVoice and VoiceDesign, IndexTTS2, IndexTTS 2.5, VoxCPM2, OmniVoice and Fish Audio S2 Pro. GPT-SoVITS and Qwen3-TTS 0.6B CustomVoice are removed, and the new models are separate downloads. On the CPU backend local speech is much slower, and the model page says so.
Voice cloning: a new capture flow takes a 30-second sample and an optional consent clip, and keeps one re-rollable seed per local engine. Google Gemini voice cloning is supported and requires the consent clip. Local cloning models use My voices directly from the reference recording. Capturing a new voice needs the desktop app. Voice exports use a new .bcvoice version; older files still import.
Dubbing with local voices no longer fails for the built-in voices of local cloning models or for My voices on local models.
New speech providers: Google Gemini TTS, and Doubao Speech as its own provider (it uses the Doubao Speech console key, not the Ark key).
Settings > Models manages API providers in one place: several accounts per provider, custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, model refresh and a new Usage page. Local and API models appear together on each capability page.
Models can be downloaded into a folder chosen for that download without changing the models folder.
Agents: Qwen Code CLI is a built-in agent. New sessions pick a ready agent when no default is set, and Make default is on each agent card. On Windows, npm-installed Codex and Pi are found and started, and quoted Codex paths are accepted.
Sessions: a new Archived sessions page with search, project filter, restore and delete; the archive notice links to it. Sessions about a downloaded video are titled from the video, and the agent can rename sessions.
Quitting while jobs or agent tasks run asks whether to keep them running in the background, stop them, or cancel, and lists remote provider calls that may still be billed.
Translation uses the lines/1 alignment carrier by default, which used about half the tokens of the previous carrier in testing, with fixes for Japanese and Korean to Chinese, Chinese to English, and spaces lost where translated spans join. Translations started before updating resume with the previous carrier.
With no effort chosen, DeepSeek V4 turns thinking off and Gemini uses its lowest thinking level, which fixes empty or truncated translation pages. Choose an effort if you want more reasoning.
Subtitles no longer split a Latin word such as Transformer in the middle inside Chinese, Japanese or Korean text.
Transcription: overlapping speech in multi-speaker recordings no longer fails local MOSS transcription or drops cloud segments, and a model output that fails validation now fails once instead of re-running and disabling the model.
Semantic search: indexing starts after a restart instead of staying at Updating 0/N videos, speech indexing shows per-video progress, and the models install from one dialog with per-component download sources. Signed macOS builds can load the LiteRT runtime.
Windows: exports decode video on the GPU by default, with fixes for B-frame timing, colour matrices and NTSC frame rates and a 2-second keyframe interval; 1080p exports were about 1.25x faster on the measured machine. Local speech recognition and Qwen-Image generation are much faster on CUDA.
After a reboot the app no longer gets stuck on Reconnecting because of leftover Runtime files.
Smaller fixes: model names, licences, service errors and Claude settings descriptions follow a language change without restarting; the template library has a close button; importing older projects runs automatically only once; the video downloader keeps Chrome listed and explains how to grant browser access; the local command gateway caps each message at 64 MiB.
New built-in explainer-video skill for knowledge and teaching videos.
macOS packages are signed and notarized; Windows CPU, CUDA and Vulkan packages are unsigned and require the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable. UI/export, live model/GPU inference and paid agent calls are outside the automated release checks.
